<description>
Fixes #36334

The "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ..." line was logged unconditionally and could not be turned off, filling the debug log when block templates are built frequently.

Move it behind a new "mining" logging category, enabled with -debug=mining.
</description>

diff --git a/src/logging.cpp b/src/logging.cpp
index bbe5f043ed..2e572b2b8f 100644
--- a/src/logging.cpp
+++ b/src/logging.cpp
@@ -209,6 +209,7 @@ static const std::map<std::string, BCLog::LogFlags, std::less<>> LOG_CATEGORIES_
     {"txpackages", BCLog::TXPACKAGES},
     {"kernel", BCLog::KERNEL},
     {"privatebroadcast", BCLog::PRIVBROADCAST},
+    {"mining", BCLog::MINING},
 };
 
 static const std::unordered_map<BCLog::LogFlags, std::string> LOG_CATEGORIES_BY_FLAG{
diff --git a/src/logging/categories.h b/src/logging/categories.h
index 4bc8724a1d..aa1b2e6e44 100644
--- a/src/logging/categories.h
+++ b/src/logging/categories.h
@@ -45,6 +45,7 @@ enum LogFlags : CategoryMask {
     TXPACKAGES = (CategoryMask{1} << 27),
     KERNEL = (CategoryMask{1} << 28),
     PRIVBROADCAST = (CategoryMask{1} << 29),
+    MINING = (CategoryMask{1} << 30),
     ALL = ~NONE,
 };
 
diff --git a/src/node/miner.cpp b/src/node/miner.cpp
index b4dbdd0ee2..3f4bd37115 100644
--- a/src/node/miner.cpp
+++ b/src/node/miner.cpp
@@ -220,7 +220,7 @@ std::unique_ptr<CBlockTemplate> BlockAssembler::CreateNewBlock()
         coinbase_tx.required_outputs.push_back(final_coinbase->vout[witness_index]);
     }
 
-    LogInfo("CreateNewBlock(): block weight: %u txs: %u fees: %ld sigops %d\n", GetBlockWeight(*pblock), nBlockTx, nFees, nBlockSigOpsCost);
+    LogDebug(BCLog::MINING, "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: %u txs: %u fees: %ld sigops %d\n", GetBlockWeight(*pblock), nBlockTx, nFees, nBlockSigOpsCost);
 
     // Fill in header
     pblock->hashPrevBlock  = pindexPrev->GetBlockHash();

@@ -424,6 +424,12 @@ class MiningTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         assert_equal(block["tx"][0]["locktime"], block["height"] - 1)
         assert_equal(block["tx"][0]["vin"][0]["sequence"], MAX_SEQUENCE_NONFINAL)
 
+    def test_mining_log_category(self):

+        node = self.nodes[0]

+
     def run_test(self):
         node = self.nodes[0]
         self.wallet = MiniWallet(node)
@@ -568,6 +574,7 @@ class MiningTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_murch_zawy_mintime()
         self.test_pruning()
         self.test_height_in_locktime()
+        self.test_mining_log_category()
 
 
 if __name__ == '__main__':
diff --git a/doc/release-notes-36336.md b/doc/release-notes-36336.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..558950c365
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-36336.md
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+Updated settings
+----------------
+
+- A new `mining` logging category has been added, enabled with `-debug=mining`.
+  The `CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ...` line, previously logged on every
+  block template build regardless of logging configuration, is now logged only
+  when this category is enabled. `getblocktemplate` and Mining IPC users are
+  encouraged to enable it to see this log and future mining logs.

</patch>
